code.Token.name(): function name() public constant returns (string name) { name; }
code.Token.totalSupply(): function totalSupply() public constant returns (uint256 totalSupply) { totalSupply; }
code.Token.approve(address,uint256): function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success);
code.Token.transfer(address,uint256): function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success);
code.Token.decimals(): function decimals() public constant returns (uint8 decimals) { decimals; }
code.Token.transferFrom(address,address,uint2: function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success);
code.Token.allowance(address,address): function allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public constant returns (uint256 remaining) { _owner; _spender; remaining; }
code.Token.symbol(): function symbol() public constant returns (string symbol) { symbol; }
code.Token.balanceOf(address): function balanceOf(address _owner) public constant returns (uint256 balance) { _owner; balance; }
